definition: The umbrella category of competition-math evaluation sets (AIME, AMC, MATH, MATH-500, HMMT, GPQA) the archive's sources use to measure test-time-compute and reasoning-length methods. BG-MCTS's budget-aware tree search and 'Reasoning Models Hallucinate More' both evaluate their methods on this class of benchmark.

evidence.note: Proposes a budget-aware Monte Carlo Tree Search policy (BG-MCTS) that reallocates exploration versus refinement as a fixed per-query token budget is consumed, for test-time scaling of LLMs.
evidence.title: Aligning Tree-Search Policies with Fixed Token Budgets in Test-Time Scaling of LLMs

evidence.note: Shows that RL fine-tuning for reasoning increases hallucination and proposes FSPO, a step-wise factuality-verified RL objective that reduces it while improving accuracy.
evidence.title: Reasoning Models Hallucinate More: Factuality-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Large Reasoning Models

name: mathematical reasoning benchmarks
